findings.finding: CLI is standalone; no signed-in Telegram port adapter, full 17-op projection, vault, sync and production daemon integration, so not Go replacement.
Nested Rust workspace has no resolved/committed lockfile; direct pins do not establish reproducible transitive dependencies or verified build.
Session file, upload source, destination directory checks are path-based with TOCTOU/ancestor symlink risks. Real account credential and floodwait/idempotency lifecycle untested.
